import os
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

# ── Download ERA5 5.625deg from WeatherBench2 (GCS zarr) and convert to npz shards ──
SAVE_DIR = '/data/era5_5.625deg'
ZARR_URL = 'gs://weatherbench2/datasets/era5/1959-2023_01_10-6h-64x32_equiangular_conservative.zarr'
NUM_SHARDS = 2

# Splits
TRAIN_YEARS = list(range(1979, 2016))  # 1979-2015 (37 years, same as paper)
VAL_YEARS = [2016]
TEST_YEARS = [2017, 2018]

# Surface variables (single-level)
SURFACE_VARS = [
    '2m_temperature',
    '10m_u_component_of_wind',
    '10m_v_component_of_wind',
]

# Pressure-level variables and needed levels
PRESSURE_VARS = [
    'geopotential',
    'u_component_of_wind',
    'v_component_of_wind',
    'temperature',
    'specific_humidity',
    'relative_humidity',
]
PRESSURE_LEVELS = [50, 250, 500, 600, 700, 850, 925]

print('Opening zarr store...', flush=True)
ds = xr.open_zarr(ZARR_URL, consolidated=True)
print(f'Dataset loaded. Dimensions: {dict(ds.dims)}', flush=True)
print(f'Available variables: {list(ds.data_vars)}', flush=True)

# Get lat/lon from dataset
# WeatherBench2 lat is south-to-north [-87.1875, ..., 87.1875]
# ClimaX needs north-to-south [87.1875, ..., -87.1875]
lat_raw = ds['latitude'].values  # south to north
lon_raw = ds['longitude'].values
lat_ns = lat_raw[::-1].copy()  # flip to north-to-south
np.save(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, 'lat.npy'), lat_ns.astype(np.float64))
np.save(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, 'lon.npy'), lon_raw.astype(np.float64))
print(f'Saved lat.npy ({lat_ns.shape}, {lat_ns[0]:.4f} to {lat_ns[-1]:.4f})', flush=True)
print(f'Saved lon.npy ({lon_raw.shape}, {lon_raw[0]:.4f} to {lon_raw[-1]:.4f})', flush=True)

# Prepare constants: land_sea_mask, orography, lattitude
# land_sea_mask: from 'land_sea_mask' variable (time-invariant, take first timestep)
# orography: from 'geopotential_at_surface' / 9.80665
# lattitude: 2D array of latitude values broadcast across lon
print('Preparing constants...', flush=True)

# land_sea_mask may be (lon, lat) or (time, lon, lat) - handle both
lsm_da = ds['land_sea_mask']
lsm_raw = lsm_da.isel(time=0).values if 'time' in lsm_da.dims else lsm_da.values  # (lon, lat)
lsm = lsm_raw.T[::-1, :]  # transpose to (lat, lon), flip lat to N->S

# orography from geopotential_at_surface
geo_da = ds['geopotential_at_surface']
geo_surf_raw = geo_da.isel(time=0).values if 'time' in geo_da.dims else geo_da.values  # (lon, lat)
orog = (geo_surf_raw / 9.80665).T[::-1, :]  # (lat, lon), N->S

# lattitude: broadcast lat to 2D (lat, lon)
lat_2d = np.broadcast_to(lat_ns[:, None], (len(lat_ns), len(lon_raw)))

constant_arrays = {
    'land_sea_mask': lsm.astype(np.float32),
    'orography': orog.astype(np.float32),
    'lattitude': lat_2d.astype(np.float32),
}
print(f'Constants prepared: {list(constant_arrays.keys())}', flush=True)

def extract_year_data(year):
    '''Extract all variables for a given year, return dict of var_name -> [T, 1, H, W] arrays.'''
    print(f'  Loading year {year}...', flush=True)
    # Select time range for the year (6-hourly data)
    time_sel = ds.sel(time=str(year))
    T = len(time_sel.time)
    print(f'    {T} timesteps for {year}', flush=True)
    
    result = {}
    
    # Constants: repeat T times -> [T, 1, H, W]
    for name, arr_2d in constant_arrays.items():
        result[name] = np.tile(arr_2d[None, None, :, :], (T, 1, 1, 1)).astype(np.float32)
    
    # Surface variables: zarr shape is (time, longitude, latitude)
    # Need (time, 1, lat_NS, lon)
    for var in SURFACE_VARS:
        print(f'    Loading surface var: {var}', flush=True)
        data = time_sel[var].values  # (T, lon, lat)
        # Transpose (T, lon, lat) -> (T, lat, lon), flip lat to N->S
        data = np.transpose(data, (0, 2, 1))[:, ::-1, :]  # (T, lat_NS, lon)
        result[var] = data[:, None, :, :].astype(np.float32)  # (T, 1, H, W)
    
    # Pressure-level variables: zarr shape is (time, level, longitude, latitude)
    # Need (time, 1, lat_NS, lon) per level
    for var in PRESSURE_VARS:
        print(f'    Loading pressure var: {var}', flush=True)
        for level in PRESSURE_LEVELS:
            vname = f'{var}_{level}'
            data = time_sel[var].sel(level=level).values  # (T, lon, lat)
            data = np.transpose(data, (0, 2, 1))[:, ::-1, :]  # (T, lat_NS, lon)
            result[vname] = data[:, None, :, :].astype(np.float32)  # (T, 1, H, W)
    
    return result

def process_partition(years, partition):
    '''Process years into npz shards with normalization and climatology.'''
    out_dir = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, partition)
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    all_means = {}  # var -> list of per-year means
    all_stds = {}   # var -> list of per-year stds
    all_clims = {}  # var -> list of per-year climatology
    
    for year in years:
        data = extract_year_data(year)
        T = list(data.values())[0].shape[0]
        
        # Compute stats
        for vname, arr in data.items():
            m = arr.mean(axis=(0, 2, 3))  # shape (1,)
            s = arr.std(axis=(0, 2, 3))
            c = arr.mean(axis=0)  # (1, H, W)
            all_means.setdefault(vname, []).append(m)
            all_stds.setdefault(vname, []).append(s)
            all_clims.setdefault(vname, []).append(c)
        
        # Write shards
        hrs_per_shard = T // NUM_SHARDS
        for shard_id in range(NUM_SHARDS):
            start = shard_id * hrs_per_shard
            end = start + hrs_per_shard if shard_id < NUM_SHARDS - 1 else T
            sharded = {k: v[start:end] for k, v in data.items()}
            out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f'{year}_{shard_id}.npz')
            np.savez(out_path, **sharded)
            print(f'    Saved {partition}/{year}_{shard_id}.npz', flush=True)
    
    # Climatology: average across years
    clim = {}
    for vname in all_clims:
        clim[vname] = np.mean(np.stack(all_clims[vname], axis=0), axis=0)
    np.savez(os.path.join(out_dir, 'climatology.npz'), **clim)
    print(f'  Saved {partition}/climatology.npz', flush=True)
    
    return all_means, all_stds

# Process all partitions
print('Processing train partition...', flush=True)
train_means, train_stds = process_partition(TRAIN_YEARS, 'train')

# Compute normalization from train data
norm_mean = {}
norm_std = {}
for vname in train_means:
    means = np.stack(train_means[vname], axis=0)  # (num_years, 1)
    stds = np.stack(train_stds[vname], axis=0)
    # Combined mean across years
    norm_mean[vname] = means.mean(axis=0)
    # Combined std: var = E[var] + var(mean)
    variance = (stds**2).mean(axis=0) + (means**2).mean(axis=0) - means.mean(axis=0)**2
    norm_std[vname] = np.sqrt(np.maximum(variance, 1e-12))

np.savez(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, 'normalize_mean.npz'), **norm_mean)
np.savez(os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, 'normalize_std.npz'), **norm_std)
print('Saved normalize_mean.npz, normalize_std.npz', flush=True)

print('Processing val partition...', flush=True)
process_partition(VAL_YEARS, 'val')

print('Processing test partition...', flush=True)
process_partition(TEST_YEARS, 'test')

ds.close()
print('All preprocessing complete.', flush=True)
"

python -c "
import os, subprocess
# Try to download pretrained ClimaX weights (5.625deg)
# Falls back gracefully - template trains from scratch if missing
WEIGHT_DIR = '/data/climax_weights'
os.makedirs(WEIGHT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
URL = 'https://huggingface.co/tungnd/climax/resolve/main/5.625deg.ckpt'
dst = os.path.join(WEIGHT_DIR, '5.625deg.ckpt')
if not os.path.exists(dst):
    ret = subprocess.run(['wget', '-q', '--no-check-certificate', '--timeout=120', '-O', dst, URL], timeout=300)
    if ret.returncode != 0:
        print(f'Warning: could not download pretrained weights (exit {ret.returncode}), will train from scratch')
        if os.path.exists(dst):
            os.remove(dst)
    else:
        sz = os.path.getsize(dst)
        if sz < 10000:
            print(f'Warning: downloaded file too small ({sz} bytes), removing')
            os.remove(dst)
        else:
            print(f'Downloaded pretrained weights to {dst} ({sz} bytes)')
print('Weights step done.')
"

import os
import numpy as np

# ── Verify all required data files ──
DATA_DIR = '/data/era5_5.625deg'
WEIGHT_DIR = '/data/climax_weights'

required = [
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'normalize_mean.npz'),
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'normalize_std.npz'),
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'lat.npy'),
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'lon.npy'),
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'val', 'climatology.npz'),
    os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'test', 'climatology.npz'),
]
missing = [f for f in required if not os.path.exists(f)]
assert not missing, f'Missing required files: {missing}'

# Pretrained weights are optional
ckpt = os.path.join(WEIGHT_DIR, '5.625deg.ckpt')
if os.path.exists(ckpt):
    print(f'Pretrained weights: {os.path.getsize(ckpt)} bytes')
else:
    print('Pretrained weights not available, will train from scratch')

for split in ['train', 'val', 'test']:
    split_dir = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, split)
    npz_files = [f for f in os.listdir(split_dir) if f.endswith('.npz') and f != 'climatology.npz']
    assert len(npz_files) > 0, f'No data shards in {split_dir}'
    print(f'{split}: {len(npz_files)} shards')

# Spot-check first shard
train_dir = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'train')
first = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(train_dir) if f.endswith('.npz') and f != 'climatology.npz')[0]
data = np.load(os.path.join(train_dir, first))
print(f'Shard {first}: {len(data.files)} variables')

# Verify expected variables from DEFAULT_VARS
DEFAULT_VARS = [
    'land_sea_mask', 'orography', 'lattitude',
    '2m_temperature', '10m_u_component_of_wind', '10m_v_component_of_wind',
    'geopotential_50', 'geopotential_250', 'geopotential_500',
    'geopotential_600', 'geopotential_700', 'geopotential_850', 'geopotential_925',
    'u_component_of_wind_50', 'u_component_of_wind_250', 'u_component_of_wind_500',
    'u_component_of_wind_600', 'u_component_of_wind_700', 'u_component_of_wind_850',
    'u_component_of_wind_925',
    'v_component_of_wind_50', 'v_component_of_wind_250', 'v_component_of_wind_500',
    'v_component_of_wind_600', 'v_component_of_wind_700', 'v_component_of_wind_850',
    'v_component_of_wind_925',
    'temperature_50', 'temperature_250', 'temperature_500',
    'temperature_600', 'temperature_700', 'temperature_850', 'temperature_925',
    'relative_humidity_50', 'relative_humidity_250', 'relative_humidity_500',
    'relative_humidity_600', 'relative_humidity_700', 'relative_humidity_850',
    'relative_humidity_925',
    'specific_humidity_50', 'specific_humidity_250', 'specific_humidity_500',
    'specific_humidity_600', 'specific_humidity_700', 'specific_humidity_850',
    'specific_humidity_925',
]

missing_vars = [v for v in DEFAULT_VARS if v not in data.files]
assert not missing_vars, f'Missing variables in shard: {missing_vars}'
print(f'All {len(DEFAULT_VARS)} DEFAULT_VARS present in shard.')

for k in sorted(data.files)[:5]:
    print(f'  {k}: shape={data[k].shape} dtype={data[k].dtype}')

# Verify shapes: [T, 1, 32, 64]
sample_arr = data[DEFAULT_VARS[3]]  # 2m_temperature
assert sample_arr.shape[1] == 1, f'Expected channel dim 1, got {sample_arr.shape[1]}'
assert sample_arr.shape[2] == 32, f'Expected 32 lat, got {sample_arr.shape[2]}'
assert sample_arr.shape[3] == 64, f'Expected 64 lon, got {sample_arr.shape[3]}'
print(f'Shape check passed: {sample_arr.shape}')

# Verify grid dimensions and lat ordering (north to south)
lat = np.load(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'lat.npy'))
lon = np.load(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'lon.npy'))
print(f'Grid: lat={lat.shape} (range {lat[0]:.4f} to {lat[-1]:.4f}), lon={lon.shape} (range {lon[0]:.4f} to {lon[-1]:.4f})')
assert lat.shape[0] == 32, f'Expected 32 latitudes, got {lat.shape[0]}'
assert lon.shape[0] == 64, f'Expected 64 longitudes, got {lon.shape[0]}'
assert lat[0] > lat[-1], f'Expected north-to-south lat ordering, got lat[0]={lat[0]}, lat[-1]={lat[-1]}'

# Verify normalization stats
mean_data = dict(np.load(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'normalize_mean.npz')))
std_data = dict(np.load(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'normalize_std.npz')))
print(f'Normalization: {len(mean_data)} variables')
for k in ['2m_temperature', 'geopotential_500']:
    if k in mean_data:
        print(f'  {k}: mean={mean_data[k]}, std={std_data[k]}')

print('All data verified successfully.')
"
